cohort: Married or cohabitating women aged 15 to 49 years in Ethiopia, totaling 6141 weighted respondents.
finding: The prevalence of infertility in the past 12 months in Ethiopia was 24.2%, with secondary infertility accounting for the majority (90.7%) of cases.
cross-section timing: Data from the 2016 Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey (EDHS).
